url.member: ?member=<slug> opens the panel for that member; survives refresh; page.js passes it as initialMember
url.chamber: ?chamber=house|senate preselects the chamber filter (honours the old /datasets/house/disclosures and /datasets/senate/disclosures redirects)
url.sort: ?sort=volume|trades|latest, default volume; omitted from the URL when default
url.q: ?q=<text> for the member search, omitted when empty

search.match: case-insensitive substring on name, also matches state and district text
search.clears_with: Escape while focused, or the clear button that appears when non-empty

rank_by.label: RANK BY

options.label: Disclosed volume
options.order: volume desc, then count desc, then name

options.label: Most trades
options.order: count desc, then volume desc, then name

options.label: Latest trade
options.order: lastTraded desc, then volume desc, then name

rank_by.pct_of_first: shown only when rank_by is volume; hidden otherwise

toolbar.filters_apply_to: gallery, dense list, and the rail's counts and chart; the rail heading says FILTERED when any filter is active
toolbar.segmented_a11y: role=radiogroup with role=radio buttons, arrow keys move, aria-checked on the active one

gallery.source: first 8 of the ranked, filtered members

card.element: button, type=button, aria-label='[Member name], rank N, disclosed volume $X'
card.hover: border darkens to --ptk-hair-strong, no lift, no shadow
card.selected: when its member is open: border --ptk-house or --ptk-senate by chamber, halo 3px at 12% of the same
card.first: always carries the emerald hairline and 8% halo; when selected, the selected treatment wins

gallery.fewer_than_8: render what exists; no empty card slots

dense_list.show_all: text button in the footer expands in place to all remaining members; label becomes SHOW LESS

row.element: tr with a button in the name cell, or the whole row as a button if table semantics are kept via role=row; Enter and Space open the panel
row.selected: background --ptk-row-selected, inset 3px left rule in the chamber colour

dense_list.volume_bar: width = member.volume / first.volume of the CURRENT sort's first member; bar is --ptk-ink; hidden when volume is zero or unknown, cell shows a middle dot

rail.heading: HOUSE VS SENATE, LOADED WINDOW
rail.window_line: <min tradedAt> TO <max tradedAt> · <N> DISCLOSURES, from loadedWindow(trades)
rail.chamber_cards: House and Senate: volume (usdShort), members, trades; tints at 6% of the chamber colour
rail.split_bar: House share left in --ptk-house, Senate right in --ptk-senate; when one side is zero the bar is a single colour, never empty

chart.aria: role=img, aria-label='Monthly trade counts, House and Senate, last twelve months'
chart.tooltip: month, House n, Senate n; keyboard reachable via a visually hidden table under the chart

rail.top_tickers: topTickers(filteredTrades, 5): ticker, bar relative to the first, count; a trade with no ticker is excluded

unchanged: push one history entry on open
focus returns to the opener on close
member_panel.opener: a card or a row; focus returns to whichever opened it

identity.seat: Party-District for House, Party-State for Senate as today

trades.expander: Show all N trades, text button under the table, expands in place; label becomes Show fewer
trades.row_link: source filing when sourceUrl is present, else no link and a middle dot in the link cell

member_panel.similar: unchanged; each item shows the 40px portrait with chamber ring

contractors.empty: No top federal contractors among the tickers traded, FY{year}.
contractors.failed: Contract data is unavailable right now.
contractors.failure_detection: the contractor request rejected or returned ok:false; never left in loading

states.loading: skeletons: 8 card skeletons in the gallery grid, rail blocks, 8 list rows; shimmer respects prefers-reduced-motion (static blocks)
states.unavailable: both feeds empty: gallery and list replaced by one line 'Disclosures are temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.' with a Retry button; rail shows middle dots
states.partial: one chamber failed: page renders the other; rail heading gains a chip 'SENATE FEED UNAVAILABLE' or 'HOUSE FEED UNAVAILABLE'
states.empty_filter: No members match. Try clearing <the last-changed filter>. with a Clear filters button
states.sample: SAMPLE DATA chip in the eyebrow whenever the fixture is served instead of the live feeds
states.reduced_motion: no shimmer travel, no bar grow-in, no card transitions

ticker.publish: usePublishTicker with the 12 most recent trades as TICKER · Member name · BUY/SELL/EXCH, unchanged

keyboard.tab_order: search, chamber group, party group, rank-by group, cards in rank order, rail chart hidden table, list rows, show all, panel when open
keyboard.cards_and_rows: Enter or Space opens the panel
keyboard.segmented: arrow keys change the value within a group
keyboard.panel: Escape closes; focus trapped while open
